subject.title: [Feature]: Cost metadata support for auto-discovered Amazon Bedrock models

question: Which pricing-overlay API should OpenClaw support for auto-discovered Amazon Bedrock models?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but the fix adds a public config contract and current repository guidance puts provider-owned behavior in plugins while keeping core config surfaces lean.

options.title: Use Bedrock plugin discovery costs
options.body: Add a costs map under plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery keyed by Bedrock model or profile id, with schema, docs, cache-key, discovery, and regression coverage.

options.title: Use a generic model-cost overlay
options.body: Add a provider-agnostic model pricing overlay that can patch discovered models across providers, accepting the broader config and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep explicit pricing only
options.body: Decline a new overlay and document that users must use explicit provider model entries or optional remote pricing catalogs for estimates.

recommendation.title: Use Bedrock plugin discovery costs
recommendation.body: Add a costs map under plugins.entries.amazon-bedrock.config.discovery keyed by Bedrock model or profile id, with schema, docs, cache-key, discovery, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history across the plugin-owned Bedrock discovery path, config-boundary refactors, and usage-cost lookup surface.
